name: Hand over fills without copying
brief:
At the end of a session the day's fills move from a staging vector into the main record. The type `Fill` (a string `id` and an `int qty`) is loaded and counts every copy made of it in `Fill::copies`.

Write `take_all(dst, src)`, which appends every fill of `src` to the end of `dst`, in order, keeps what `dst` already holds, makes no copy of any `Fill`, and leaves `src` empty. The caller writes `take_all(dst, std::move(src))`.

With `dst` holding `a0` and `src` holding `b0` and `b1`, `dst` ends as `a0`, `b0`, `b1`, `src` is empty, and `Fill::copies` is still 0.
constraints: `src` and `dst` hold up to 10,000 fills each, and either may be empty.
A copy anywhere, including inside a loop variable or a vector insert, adds 1 to `Fill::copies`.
hint: A named variable is an lvalue even when its type is `Fill&&`. Moving each element needs `std::move` on that element.

examples.note: A helper fills dst with a0 and src with b0, b1, then reads copies, both sizes and every id.
An empty dst simply receives the three.

tests.call: []{ std::vector<Fill> d = make_fills("a", 5), s = make_fills("b", 400); Fill::copies = 0; take_all(d, std::move(s)); return std::vector<int>{Fill::copies, (int)d.size(), (int)s.size(), d[404].qty}; }()

[]{ std::vector<Fill> d, s = make_fills("b", 2); take_all(d, std::move(s)); s.emplace_back("c0", 9); take_all(d, std::move(s)); std::string ids; for (const Fill& f : d) ids += f.id + " "; return ids + std::to_string(s.size()); }()

how: Submit runs 8 hidden tests. Each answer must equal the expected value. The first number each helper returns is `Fill::copies`, which must be 0.
notes: `std::move(f)` on each element picks `Fill`'s move constructor, which takes the string's buffer instead of copying it.
Moved-from fills are still elements of `src`, so `src.clear()` is needed to leave it empty.
Inside the function `src` has a name, so it is an lvalue; `&&` only says the caller gave it up.

planted.slip: Inserting the range copies every fill instead of moving it.
The loop variable is taken by value, so each fill is copied before it is moved.
Moves each fill but leaves the emptied shells in src.
